description: Test helper functions for device authorization, pairing, token issuance, and WebSocket connection management in the openclaw project.

methods.name: resolveDeviceIdentityPath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a device identity JSON based on environment variables and device name.

methods.name: loadDeviceIdentity
methods.description: Loads or creates a device identity and returns its path, identity object, and public key.

methods.name: pairDeviceIdentity
methods.description: Performs device pairing by requesting and approving device pairing, returning identity info.

methods.name: issueOperatorToken
methods.description: Pairs a device as an operator and optionally rotates its token, returning device ID, path, and token.

methods.name: openTrackedWs
methods.description: Opens a WebSocket connection to localhost on a specified port and tracks the connection challenge nonce.
